query: What are the main differences between lithium iron phosphate and NMC battery chemistries?
context:
Source: https://batteryuniversity.com/article/bu-205-types-of-lithium-ion
Title: BU-205: Types of Lithium-ion - Battery University
Content: Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) offers good thermal stability and a long cycle life but a lower nominal voltage (3.2 V) and lower specific energy than lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC), whose nominal voltage is 3.6-3.7 V.
